# Generated by tools/build_equipment.py. The Soul Forge window (player scope).
ac_forge_close = { scope = character effect = { ac_forge_close_effect = yes } }
ac_forge_choose = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { flag }
	is_shown = { var:ac_forge_template ?= scope:flag }
	is_valid = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_forge_board } }
	effect = { set_variable = { name = ac_forge_template value = scope:flag } }
}
ac_forge_prepare = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		custom_tooltip = { text = ac_forge_choose_first_tt has_variable = ac_forge_template }
		custom_tooltip = { text = ac_forge_cooldown_tt NOT = { has_variable = ac_forge_cooldown } }
		NOT = { has_variable = ac_forge_board }
	}
	effect = { custom_tooltip = ac_forge_prepare_tt hidden_effect = { ac_forge_create_board_effect = yes } }
}
ac_forge_reroll = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		has_variable = ac_forge_board
		custom_tooltip = { text = ac_forge_no_rerolls_tt ac_forge_rerolls_left > 0 }
		custom_tooltip = { text = ac_forge_reroll_started_tt NOT = { has_variable = ac_forge_current } }
	}
	effect = {
		custom_tooltip = ac_forge_reroll_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			ac_forge_clear_board_effect = yes
			if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_forge_rerolls } change_variable = { name = ac_forge_rerolls add = 1 } }
			else = { set_variable = { name = ac_forge_rerolls value = 1 } }
			ac_forge_create_board_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
ac_forge_node = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { story }
	is_shown = { var:ac_forge_current ?= scope:story }
	is_valid = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = ac_forge_owner var:ac_forge_smith ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = ac_forge_smith } var:ac_forge_item ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = ac_forge_item }
		custom_tooltip = { text = ac_forge_used_tt scope:story = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_forge_used } } }
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_forge_current } }
			custom_tooltip = { text = ac_forge_start_here_tt scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:start }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			custom_tooltip = { text = ac_forge_not_start_tt NOT = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:start } }
			custom_tooltip = { text = ac_forge_too_far_tt ac_forge_linked_trigger = { A = var:ac_forge_current B = scope:story } }
			custom_tooltip = { text = ac_forge_no_moves_tt ac_forge_moves_left > 0 }
		}
		scope:story = { ac_forge_node_requirement_trigger = yes }
	}
	effect = { ac_forge_step_effect = yes }
}
ac_forge_hover_enter = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { story }
	effect = { scope:story = { every_in_list = { variable = lines limit = { NOT = { var:opacity = 1 } } set_variable = { name = opacity value = 0.6 } } } }
}
ac_forge_hover_leave = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { story }
	effect = { scope:story = { every_in_list = { variable = lines limit = { NOT = { var:opacity = 1 } } set_variable = { name = opacity value = 0.25 } } } }
}

	scope = character
	is_valid = { custom_tooltip = { text = ac_forge_unstarted_tt has_variable = ac_forge_current } }
	effect = { custom_tooltip = ac_forge_finish_tt hidden_effect = { ac_forge_finish_effect = yes } }
